title: Setup: build Spring Boot #51173 (S19) at both pins and run its landed tests
description: Setup job for llm-dlc/loops/spring-boot-merged-pr-links-s01-s50-brief.md, case S19 (spring-projects/spring-boot#51173: Embedded Tomcat returns a relative redirect by default). In the worktrees $P/worktrees/S19-{fix,parent} (P = ~/.cache/in-the-loop/spring-boot-pr-links-s01-s50), offline (dependencies resolved online beforehand), it builds the jars of module:spring-boot-tomcat with the Gradle each checkout's wrapper names on JDK 25, runs the landed test classes (TomcatServletWebServerFactoryCustomizerTests (test) TomcatServerPropertiesTests (test) SampleOAuth2ClientApplicationTests (test) ) at the fix and those of them that exist at the parent, keeps the jars, SHA256SUMS (jars and every class of the changed production sources) and the runtime and test runtime classpaths of module:spring-boot-tomcat smoke-test:spring-boot-smoke-test-oauth2-client in $P/artifacts/S19-ROLE, then runs the fix's changed test files on a copy of the parent, where they are expected to fail or not compile, and removes the build trees. Script: $P/scripts/case_job.sh. No claims, no verifier.
expected: every step exits 0: fix and parent BUILD SUCCESSFUL with failures=0 errors=0 for the landed classes; transplant prints TRANSPLANT-FAILS-AS-EXPECTED or TRANSPLANT-DOES-NOT-COMPILE-AS-EXPECTED; clean prints cleaned S19

resources.notes: the reruns of 2026-11-27 took 5-7 minutes with a peak of 3.8-4.6 GiB

S19 parent: build and the parent's tests
